question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

So Mahesh is much sensitive, / we are very careful / when communicating with him / about his failures.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the use of "**much sensitive**" instead of "**very sensitive**."
 
• The word "sensitive" is an adjective and should be modified by "very" instead of "much" in this context.
 
• The correct phrase should be "**very sensitive**," ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 2** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"So Mahesh is very sensitive, we are very careful when communicating with him about his failures."*
